q1.explanationZh: 第二段说影响食量的有从小形成的习惯、食物分量和背景音乐，没有提到最近体重的变化，所以选 C。

evidence.quote: People form food-related habits at a young age.
Meanwhile, the serving size and the background music can both affect how much we eat.

q2.explanationZh: 第三段说和体重正常的人相比，胖的人看到美食会更兴奋。

evidence.quote: Compared to people of normal weight, fat people feel more excited when they see delicious food.

q3.explanationZh: 第四段说胃饥饿素告诉大脑身体想要食物，让我们去找吃的。

evidence.quote: tells the brain that the body wants food

q4.explanationZh: 第四段说胖的人瘦素水平升高后，大脑最后不再相信瘦素，不再理会它发出的“警告”。

evidence.quote: they would no longer trust leptin and would stop responding to its “warnings”

q5.explanationZh: right 后面要名词，decide 的名词是 decision，“做出决定”是 make a decision。

q6.explanationZh: His 后面要名词，think 的名词是 thought（想法；思考）。

q7.explanationZh: 空在 a 和名词 stroke 之间，要形容词，rarely 的形容词是 rare，意思是“难得的”。

q8.explanationZh: 这里是 how much she 后接动词，意思是“她称出多重”，weight 作动词，用过去式 weighed，和前面的 stepped 时态一致。

q9.explanationZh: 空在 had 和名词 problems 之间，要形容词，variety 的形容词是 various（各种各样的）。

accept: How much we eat is affected
The amount we eat is affected
How much we eat is influenced

q10.explanationZh: “食量”用 how much we eat 做主语，“受到……影响”用被动 is affected by。

accept: have a tough time losing weight
have a hard time losing weight

q11.explanationZh: “很难做某事”是 have a tough time doing sth，often 后面接动词原形 have。

q12.explanationZh: “各种各样的”是 a variety of，后面接复数名词 hormones（激素）。
q12.tipsZh: a variety of 各种各样的

accept: but their bodies are working against their will
but their bodies are going against their will
but their bodies work against their will

q13.explanationZh: “违背他们的意愿”是 work against their will，原文用现在进行时 are working，前面用 but 连接。
